metaTitle: Custom Cotton Poly Badge Reels | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom cotton poly badge reels for your team. Durable, comfortable fabric ID holders. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Cotton poly badge reels offer a softer, more professional look than standard plastic reels, making them a preferred choice for healthcare facilities, hospitality staff, and corporate offices. The blended fabric feels comfortable against clothing and resists fraying, even after repeated use. These reels hold ID badges securely while adding a subtle, uniform-friendly touch. Choose from full-color imprinting to display your logo, department name, or event branding on the fabric surface.
heroAltText: Custom cotton poly badge reels with a printed logo, featuring a durable fabric strap and metal clip for ID badges.
